verdict: CONFIRMED (corrected): corroborated triples are negation-flagged at 26.1%, against 26.1% expected purely from having ~2.65 extraction events each at a 10.8% per-event rate. The first run compared against the raw base rate and reported 2.4x contamination that is entirely the flag's own bias. exp75 shows no evidence of negation contamination.
scope: Per-sentence extraction so each triple can be attributed to its source sentence, unlike exp75 which chunked. A triple counts as negation-sourced if ANY of its extractions came from a negated sentence, which overstates rather than understates.
